passwordReset.subject: Reset your ShareTab password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password for the ShareTab account {email}.
passwordReset.expiry: The link works once and expires in 1 hour.
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

passwordChanged.subject: Your ShareTab password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.intro: The password for the ShareTab account {email} was just changed, and every device signed in to it before the change was signed out.
passwordChanged.notYou: If you didn't do this, reset your password now and tell your ShareTab administrator.
